The decisive mistake was the Orchestrator's instruction at step 37. It asked WebSurfer to find the July 2020 paper by "one of the same authors as the March 2021 paper" without naming them. The March 2021 paper's authors (Nicastro, Guidorzi, Palazzi, Zampieri, Turatto, Gardini) were already known from step 8. Without them, WebSurfer's search (step 39) returned unrelated papers, and the team later downloaded "The Multiwavelength Counterparts of Fast Radio Bursts" by Chen, Ravi, and Lu (steps 47–55), which shares no authors with the March 2021 paper. The chain never obtained the correct July 2020 paper or its burst-1 timing, so the final "31" was unsupported.

AGENT: Orchestrator (-> WebSurfer)
STEP: 37
